intro_p: Use the interactive map to explore Serracapriola, find the main points of interest and activate GPS navigation to the village or to a specific location.
p_poi: Click on a point of interest to open navigation in Google Maps.
p_auto_nord: From the North (Pescara/Lanciano): A14 Adriatic Motorway to Foggia Nord, then SS16 heading South towards Lesina-Serracapriola. Exit at Serracapriola.
p_auto_sud: From the South (Foggia/Bari): SS17 heading North, then SS16 towards Pescara until the exit for Serracapriola.
p_treno: Adriatic Line (Trenitalia). Station: Serracapriola-Chieuti. The historic centre is about 4 km from the station, reachable by taxi or private transport.
p_aereo: Foggia Airport "Gino Lisa" (~50 km) — Pescara Airport (~120 km) — Bari Airport "Karol Wojtyla" (~160 km)
